2. Scope of Services
We provide professional and technology services that may include:
Claris FileMaker Solutions: Custom application design, database architecture, development, integration, and ongoing support as detailed in the project's Statement of Work (SOW).
AI Enablement & Training: Strategic workshops, team training, and development of AI frameworks. Specific deliverables and learning outcomes will be outlined in our Proposal.

Fractional CTO Services: A strategic advisory service provided on a retainer basis. This service includes technology leadership, strategic planning, team mentorship, and project oversight as defined in our agreement.

Service details, pricing, and deliverables will be outlined in individual Service Agreements, Statements of Work (SOW), or proposals accepted by both parties. Clients may also access select services through packaged offerings available for direct purchase, subscription, or booking on our website. Each package clearly defines the scope, duration, and deliverables to ensure transparency, flexibility, and alignment with client goals.
3. Engagement and Client Responsibilities
By engaging with 2nspira LLC, you agree to:
Provide timely access to information, systems, and personnel necessary for project completion;
Ensure that any data or materials you provide are lawful, accurate, and do not infringe third-party rights;

We rely on your cooperation to meet timelines and deliverables. Delays in client response or required access may impact project delivery dates.
4. Payment Terms
Unless otherwise agreed in writing:
Invoices are due within 15 days of issuance.
Late payments may incur interest at 1.5% per month or the maximum allowed by law.
Subscription or managed services may renew automatically unless canceled before the renewal date.
Project fees are billed according to the agreed SOW (hourly, fixed, or milestone-based).
Fractional CTO and other retainer-based services are billed monthly in advance and are non-refundable for the service period.
You are responsible for all applicable taxes and transaction fees.
We reserve the right to suspend work for non-payment.

5.2 Work Product
Unless otherwise specified in a signed agreement. Our goal is for you to own the work you pay for, while we protect the tools and expertise that make our work possible.
Client Ownership: Upon full and final payment for a project, you (the Client) will own the specific, finished deliverable we created for you (e.g., the completed FileMaker application).

Our Retained Tools: 2nspira LLC retains full ownership of all our underlying pre-existing code, libraries, development tools, and proprietary methodologies. We grant you a permanent, royalty-free license to use these embedded tools as part of your deliverable.
Any custom software or database created in Claris FileMaker remains your property upon payment in full, except for embedded proprietary components that remain ours.
6. Confidentiality

Restrict access to authorized personnel; and
Implement reasonable technical and administrative safeguards.
Confidentiality obligations survive termination of this Agreement.
7. Data Protection and Cybersecurity
We prioritize the protection of client data and follow recognized cybersecurity frameworks such as NIST and ISO/IEC 27001.
Our safeguards include:

Access control and least-privilege permissions
Multi-factor authentication
Secure data backups
Network monitoring and incident response protocols

Clients are responsible for maintaining appropriate cybersecurity on their own networks and systems.
